var TCVREC=(function(){
 const D=(typeof TCVREC_DATA!=='undefined'&&TCVREC_DATA)||{lines:{},voices:{},modes:{},names:{}};
 const MODES=D.modes||{},VOICES=D.voices||{},NAMES=D.names||{};
 const st={n:0,bytes:D.bytes||0,played:0,ended:0,fail:0,fallback:0,timed:0,queued:0,decoded:0,released:0,bufBytes:0,bufN:0,phone:0,err:null,log:[],mode:D.defMode||Object.keys(MODES)[0]||'off'};
 for(const t in D.lines||{})st.n+=Object.keys(D.lines[t]).length;
 try{const m=localStorage.getItem('tcVrec');if(m&&(m==='off'||MODES[m]))st.mode=m}catch(e){}
 const vInfo=id=>VOICES[id]||{name:id};
  
 const voiceFor=(who,text)=>{if(st.mode==='off')return null;const M=MODES[st.mode]||{};return (text!=null&&M.over&&M.over[text])||(M.cast||{})[who]||null};
 const rec=(text,vid)=>{const L=D.lines&&D.lines[text];return L&&vid?L[vid]||null:null};
 const recFor=(who,text)=>rec(text,voiceFor(who,text));
 const phoneVoice=()=>st.mode==='off'?null:((MODES[st.mode]||{}).phone||D.phone||null);
 function setMode(m){if(m!=='off'&&!MODES[m])m=D.defMode||'off';st.mode=m;try{localStorage.setItem('tcVrec',m)}catch(e){}return m}
 function ac(){try{return TCSND.ensure()}catch(e){return null}}
 const bytesOf=b=>b?b.length*b.numberOfChannels*4:0;
  
 const BUF=new Map();    
 function ab64(s){const bin=atob(typeof tcNv64==='function'?tcNv64(s):s),u=new Uint8Array(bin.length);for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++)u[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);return u.buffer}
 function load(text,vid){const k=vid+'|'+text,e0=BUF.get(k);if(e0)return e0.p;const R=rec(text,vid),c=ac();if(!R||!c)return Promise.resolve(null);
  const e={p:null,b:null};BUF.set(k,e);
  e.p=new Promise(res=>{let done=false;const ok=b=>{if(done)return;done=true;if(BUF.get(k)===e){e.b=b;st.decoded++;st.bufN++;st.bufBytes+=bytesOf(b)}res(b)},bad=er=>{if(done)return;done=true;st.fail++;st.err='decode: '+String(er&&er.message||er||'').slice(0,80);if(BUF.get(k)===e)BUF.delete(k);res(null)};
   try{const r=c.decodeAudioData(ab64(R[1]),ok,bad);if(r&&r.catch)r.catch(bad)}catch(er){bad(er)}});
  return e.p}
 function release(){let n=0;for(const [k,e] of [...BUF]){BUF.delete(k);if(e.b){st.bufBytes-=bytesOf(e.b);st.bufN--;n++}}st.released+=n;return n}
  
 function playRec(job){const c=ac();job.state='load';
  const go=b=>{if(job.dead)return;if(!b||!c){fallback(job);return}
   const start=()=>{if(job.dead)return;try{const s=c.createBufferSource(),g=c.createGain();s.buffer=b;g.gain.value=job.gain!=null?job.gain:1;s.connect(g);
     g.connect(job.dest||(typeof TCAUDIO!=='undefined'&&TCAUDIO.busFor&&TCAUDIO.busFor(TCSND.st.ctx)||{}).voice||TCSND.st.master||c.destination);    job.src=s;job.g=g;job.dur=b.duration;
     s.onended=()=>{if(job.dead)return;job.endW=performance.now();finish(job)};
     s.start();job.state='play';job.t0W=performance.now();st.played++;
     try{job.cb&&job.cb.onstart&&job.cb.onstart()}catch(e){}}catch(e){st.err=String(e&&e.message||e).slice(0,120);fallback(job)}};
    
   if(c.state==='running')start();else{try{c.resume()}catch(e){}const w0=performance.now();const wait=()=>{if(job.dead)return;if(c.state==='running'){start();return}if(paused&&!job.own){setTimeout(wait,120);return}if(performance.now()-w0>1500){fallback(job);return}setTimeout(wait,60)};wait()}};
  const e=BUF.get(job.vid+'|'+job.text);if(e&&e.b)go(e.b);else load(job.text,job.vid).then(go)}
  
 function fallback(job){if(job.dead)return;st.fallback++;job.state='fb';
  if(job.own){try{job.onfail&&job.onfail()}catch(e){}finish(job);return}

var TCSVG=(function(){const C=new Map(),stats={compiled:0,canvases:0,err:null};
 function tf(m,t){if(!t)return m;const re=/(translate|scale|rotate|matrix|skewX|skewY)\s*\(([^)]*)\)/g;let q;while((q=re.exec(t))){const a=q[2].split(/[\s,]+/).filter(Boolean).map(Number);

 function num(n,k,d){const v=parseFloat(n.getAttribute(k));return Number.isFinite(v)?v:d}
 function shape(n){const t=n.tagName.toLowerCase(),p=new Path2D();
  if(t==='path')return new Path2D(n.getAttribute('d')||'');
  if(t==='circle'){p.arc(num(n,'cx',0),num(n,'cy',0),num(n,'r',0),0,Math.PI*2);return p}
  if(t==='ellipse'){p.ellipse(num(n,'cx',0),num(n,'cy',0),num(n,'rx',0),num(n,'ry',0),0,0,Math.PI*2);return p}
  if(t==='rect'){const x=num(n,'x',0),y=num(n,'y',0),w=num(n,'width',0),h=num(n,'height',0);let rx=num(n,'rx',NaN),ry=num(n,'ry',NaN);if(!Number.isFinite(rx))rx=Number.isFinite(ry)?ry:0;if(!Number.isFinite(ry))ry=rx;rx=Math.min(rx,w/2);ry=Math.min(ry,h/2);
   if(rx>0||ry>0){p.moveTo(x+rx,y);p.lineTo(x+w-rx,y);p.ellipse(x+w-rx,y+ry,rx,ry,0,-Math.PI/2,0);p.lineTo(x+w,y+h-ry);p.ellipse(x+w-rx,y+h-ry,rx,ry,0,0,Math.PI/2);p.lineTo(x+rx,y+h);p.ellipse(x+rx,y+h-ry,rx,ry,0,Math.PI/2,Math.PI);p.lineTo(x,y+ry);p.ellipse(x+rx,y+ry,rx,ry,0,Math.PI,Math.PI*1.5);p.closePath()}else p.rect(x,y,w,h);return p}
  return null}

  function glass(c, F, x, y, w, h, s, o) {
    o = o || {};
    if (F.night) {
      var lit = o.lit != null ? o.lit : s < .62;
      if (lit && o.inside) { o.inside(c, x, y, w, h); R(c, 'rgba(255,236,190,.12)', x, y, w, h); return true; }
      if (lit) { var warm = s < .3 ? ['#ffe2a6', '#f4b860'] : s < .5 ? ['#fff1cf', '#ffd27d'] : ['#e8f2ff', '#bcd2ef'];
        R(c, lg(c, 0, y, 0, y + h, warm), x, y, w, h);
        if (s > .12 && h > 4) { R(c, 'rgba(120,70,30,.28)', x, y, w * (.18 + s * .2), h); }   
      } else R(c, lg(c, 0, y, 0, y + h, ['#1d2a38', '#121b26']), x, y, w, h);
      return lit;
    }
    R(c, lg(c, 0, y, 0, y + h, o.tint || ['#b9d3e3', '#6f93ad', '#3e5d76']), x, y, w, h);
    c.save(); c.beginPath(); c.rect(x, y, w, h); c.clip();
    P(c, [[x + w * .15, y], [x + w * .15 + h * .5, y], [x + w * .15 - h * .1, y + h], [x + w * .15 - h * .6, y + h]], 'rgba(255,255,255,.28)');
    P(c, [[x + w * .62, y], [x + w * .62 + h * .18, y], [x + w * .62 - h * .3, y + h], [x + w * .62 - h * .48, y + h]], 'rgba(255,255,255,.13)');
    if (o.inside) o.inside(c, x, y, w, h);
    else if (s > .55 && h > 4) R(c, s > .8 ? 'rgba(240,236,224,.55)' : 'rgba(200,170,140,.4)', x + w * (s > .8 ? .62 : 0), y, w * .38, h);   
    c.restore();
    return false;
  }
  
  function win(c, F, x, w, z0, hz, o) {
    o = o || {}; var y0 = Y(F, z0 + hz), h = hz * M * K, s = hash(Math.round(x), Math.round(z0 * 10), F.seed + (o.seed || 0)), fr = o.frame || '#eef0ef';

    var dn = o.shutter != null ? o.shutter : (s > .7 ? .25 + (s - .7) * 2.2 : s < .08 ? 1 : 0);        
    if (F.night && !o.noShutter && s > .86) dn = 1;
    if (gh > 0) {
      var panes = o.panes || (w > 14 ? 2 : 1), pw = gw / panes;
      for (var i = 0; i < panes; i++) { var l = glass(c, F, gx + i * pw + (i ? .35 : 0), gy, pw - (i ? .35 : 0), gh, (s + i * .37) % 1, { lit: F.night ?       if (o.transom && gh > 6) R(c, F.night ? '#2c343e' : fr, gx, gy + gh * .3, gw, .5);
      if (!o.noShutter && dn > 0) {

      }
    }
    if (!o.noShutter && o.box !== false) { R(c, F.night ? '#3d4550' : (o.boxCol || '#f3f3ef'), x - .4, y0 - 1.8, w + .8, 1.8); R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.12)', x - .4, y0 - .25, w + .8, .25); }

    if (o.ac && s > .45) acUnit(c, F, x + w * (s > .7 ? .55 : .05), z0 - .75);
    if (o.plant && s > .25 && s < .5) plantPot(c, x + w * .2, y0 + h - .2, s);
    return lit;
  }

  function tileRoof(c, Rc, h, rg, N, base0) { var ov = 5, x0 = Rc[0] - ov, x1 = Rc[2] + ov, y0 = Rc[1] - ov - h * M * K, y1 = Rc[3] + ov - h * M * K, r = (y1 - y0) / 2, t = rg * M * K, ym = (y0 + y1) / 2 - t;

      if (!N) { var ya = Math.min.apply(null, pts.map(function (p) { return p[1]; })), yb = Math.max.apply(null, pts.map(function (p) { return p[1]; })), xa = Math.min.apply(null, pts.map(function (p) { return p[0]; })), xb = Math.max.apply(null, pts.map(function (p) { return p[0]; }));

      c.restore(); };
    face([A, B, Q, Pp], mix(base, '#e7a27c', .38), 1);

    c.strokeStyle = N ? 'rgba(0,0,0,.5)' : 'rgba(58,26,14,.55)'; c.lineWidth = .8; c.beginPath(); c.moveTo(A[0], A[1]); c.lineTo(B[0], B[1]); c.lineTo(C[0], C[1]); c.lineTo(D[0], D[1]); c.closePath(); c.stroke();

  function rbox(c, x, y, w, d, z0, hz, col, N, shadowA) {

    return { top: t, face: t + d, b: b };
  }

  var SIGNQA = { on: false, list: [],
    add: function (c, x, y, w, h, t) { try { var m = c.getTransform(), X0 = Math.floor(m.a * x + m.c * y + m.e), Y0 = Math.floor(m.b * x + m.d * y + m.f), W = Math.ceil(w * m.a) + 1, Hh = Math.ceil(h * m.d) + 1;
        var cw = c.canvas.width, chh = c.canvas.height, x0 = Math.max(0, X0), y0 = Math.max(0, Y0), x1 = Math.min(cw, X0 + W), y1 = Math.min(chh, Y0 + Hh);
        if (x1 - x0 < 2 || y1 - y0 < 2) { SIGNQA.list.push({ t: t, clip: true }); return; }
        SIGNQA.list.push({ t: t, r: [x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0], cut: (x0 > X0 || y0 > Y0 || x1 < X0 + W || y1 < Y0 + Hh), d: c.getImageData(x0, y0, x1 - x0, y1 - y0).data }); } catch (e) { SIGNQA.list.push({ t: t, err: String(e) }); } },
    check: function (c) { return SIGNQA.list.map(function (s) { if (!s.r) return { t: s.t, f: s.clip ? 1 : 0, clip: !!s.clip, err: s.err || null };
        var d = c.getImageData(s.r[0], s.r[1], s.r[2], s.r[3]).data, n = 0, tot = d.length / 4;
        for (var i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) { if (Math.abs(d[i] - s.d[i]) + Math.abs(d[i + 1] - s.d[i + 1]) + Math.abs(d[i + 2] - s.d[i + 2]) > 60) n++; }
        return { t: s.t, f: +(n / tot).toFixed(3), clip: !!s.cut }; }); } };
  function textSign(c, x, y, t, fs, bg, fg, N, font) { c.font = '700 ' + fs + 'px ' + (font || SANS); var w = c.measureText(t).width + fs; if (bg) { R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.28)', x - w / 2 + .8, y - fs * .75 + 1, w, fs * 1.5); RR(c, x - w / 2, y - fs * .75, w, fs * 1.5, 1.5, N ? sh(bg, .1) : bg); }

  function scl(Wp, v, base) { return v * Wp / (base || 320); }     
  function outOf(x, w, skip) { if (!skip) return x; if (x + w > skip[0] - 6 && x < skip[1] + 6) return (x + w / 2 < (skip[0] + skip[1]) / 2) ? skip[0] - 8 - w : skip[1] + 8; return x; }

  function houseType(o) {

      else MAT.stone(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, col); }

        downpipe(c, F, x0 + 1, F.h); downpipe(c, F, x1 - 2.2, F.h);
      },
      ground: function (c, foot, rot, N, ph) { if (rot !== 0) return; var Wf = foot[0], Df = foot[1], u = Wf / n;
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { if (!ph) paving(c, i * u + u * .12 - 3, Df, 17, 7, N, '#d6cfc0'); else planter(c, i * u + u * .55, Df + 6, 14, N); } }
    };
  }
  function aptType(o) {
    var W = o.W, D = o.D, Wp = W * M, Dp = D * M, gh = 3.3, fh = 3.15, rr = { x: W / 2 - 2.3, y: D * .44, w: 4.6, d: 4.2 }, skip = o.skip || null, NF = o.nf || 5, HH = gh + (NF - 1) * fh, RG = o.tile ? +(D * .27).toFixed(2) : 0;
    var bays = Math.max(4, Math.round(W / 5.3)); if (bays % 2) bays++;
    var c0 = bays / 2 - 1, c1 = bays / 2, last = bays - 1, zf = function (f) { return f ? gh + (f - 1) * fh : 0; }, rnd = o.mat === 'render';
    function mat(c, F, x0, x1, front) { if (rnd) { MAT.render(c, F, x0, x1, 3.3, F.h, front ? '#f5f2eb' : '#f2efe8'); MAT.stone(c, F, x0, x1, 0, 3.3, '#d9c8a6'); band(c, F, x0, x1, 3.15, .3, '#ffffff'); }
      else { MAT.stone(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, front ? '#e6d8bb' : '#e2d4b6'); R(c, F.night ? '#2e3540' : '#f3efe6', x0, Y(F, .9), x1 - x0, .9 * M * K); } }
    return {
      he: o.he, use: 'res', W: W, D: D, floors: NF, gh: gh, fh: fh,
      masses: function () { return o.tile ? [{ x: 0, y: 0, w: W, d: D, h: HH, main: true, tile: true, ridge: RG }] : [{ x: 0, y: 0, w: W, d: D, h: HH, main: true }, { x: rr.x, y: rr.y, w: rr.w, d: rr.d, h: HH + 2.7, roofRoom: true }]; },
      roof: function (c, Rc, h, m, N) { if (o.tile) { tileRoof(c, Rc, h, RG, N); return; } flatRoof(c, Rc, h, { night: N, col: '#cfd0cb', rim: '#f2ece0' }); var X = Rc[0], Yr = Rc[1], wp = Rc[2] - Rc[0], dp = Rc[3] - Rc[1];
        var cols = heaterCols(wp, wp * .37, wp * .6, skip); for (var i = 0; i < cols.length; i++) for (var r2 = 0; r2 < (dp > 96 ? 2 : 1); r2++) solarHeater(c, X + cols[i], Yr + (dp > 96 ? 14 : 7) + r2 * 26, h, N);
        antenna(c, X + outOf(scl(wp, 120), 4, skip), Yr + dp * .72, h, N); dish(c, X + outOf(scl(wp, 104), 6, skip), Yr + dp * .78, h, N); dish(c, X + outOf(scl(wp, 222), 6, skip), Yr + dp * .81, h, N);
        hvac(c, X + outOf(Math.min(scl(wp, 236), wp - 46), 40, skip), Yr + dp * .64, h, 40, 14, N); rbox(c, X + outOf(scl(wp, 70), 9, skip), Yr + dp * .72, 9, 9, h, .4, '#a9b0b5', N); },
      roofRoom: function (c, x, y, w, d, z0, hz, N) { var r = roofRoomBox(c, x, y, w, d, z0, hz, rnd ? '#f1eee7' : '#ece6d8', N); door(c, { yb: r.face + hz * M * K, night: N, seed: 3 }, x + 8, 10, 2.1, { solid: N ? '#3a414a' : '#8a939a' }); acUnit(c, { yb: r.face + hz * M * K, night: N }, x + 24, 1.2); },
      wall: function (c, F, m, side) {
        var x0 = F.x0, x1 = F.x1, Wx = x1 - x0, N = F.night;
        if (side === 'E' || side === 'W') { mat(c, F, x0, x1, false); for (var f = 0; f < NF; f++) { win(c, F, x0 + 14, 14, zf(f) + .9, 1.45, { ac: true, seed: f }); win(c, F, x1 - 34, 14, zf(f) + .9, 1.45, { seed: f + 9 }); } band(c, F, x0, x1, F.h - .25, .45, '#f4efe4'); return; }
        var front = side === 'S'; mat(c, F, x0, x1, front);
        var bw = Wx / bays;
        for (var f2 = 1; f2 < NF; f2++) band(c, F, x0, x1, zf(f2) - .12, .24, rnd ? '#ffffff' : '#f1ebdf');
        for (var b = 0; b < bays; b++) { var bx = x0 + b * bw;
          for (var f3 = 0; f3 < NF; f3++) { var z0 = zf(f3);
            if (front) {
              if (b === c0 || b === c1) { if (f3 === 0) continue;
                if (b === c0) { win(c, F, bx + bw - 12, 24, z0 + .35, 2.5, { noShutter: true, panes: 2, frame: '#dcd7cb', seed: 70 + f3, lit: N ? true : null }); win(c, F, bx + 6, 12, z0 + .95, 1.45, { ac: true, seed: 50 + f3 }); }
                else win(c, F, bx + bw - 20, 12, z0 + .95, 1.45, { ac: true, seed: 40 + f3 });
                continue; }
              if ((b === 0 || b === last) && f3 > 0) { loggia(c, F, bx + 4, bw - 8, z0, { rail: 'glass' }); continue; }
              win(c, F, bx + 6, bw * .5, z0 + .95, 1.45, { ac: true, plant: true, seed: b * 5 + f3 }); win(c, F, bx + bw * .68, bw * .2, z0 + 1.25, 1.15, { seed: b * 9 + f3, panes: 1 });
            } else {
              if (f3 > 0 && (b === 0 || b === c0 || b === c1 || b === last)) { loggia(c, F, bx + 3, bw - 6, z0, { rail: b % 2 ? 'solid' : 'glass', railCol: rnd ? '#ffffff' : '#efe9dc' }); continue; }
              win(c, F, bx + 7, bw * .42, z0 + .95, 1.45, { ac: true, plant: true, seed: b * 3 + f3 }); win(c, F, bx + bw * .62, bw * .26, z0 + .95, 1.45, { seed: b * 7 + f3 + 1 });
            }
          }
        }
        if (!front) for (var f4 = 1; f4 < NF; f4++) for (var q = 1; q < last; q++) if (q !== c0 && q !== c1 && (q === 1 || q === last - 1 || (q % 2 && bays > 6))) balcony(c, F, x0 + q * bw + 6, bw - 12, zf(f4), .9, { rail: 'bars' });
        if (front) {
          var lx = x0 + c0 * bw + 6, lw = 2 * bw - 12;
          R(c, N ? '#283039' : '#d9d3c4', lx - 2, Y(F, 3.2), lw + 4, 3.2 * M * K);
          win(c, F, lx + 4, lw / 2 - 18, .35, 2.4, { noShutter: true, panes: 2, frame: '#5e676f', lit: true, seed: 5 }); win(c, F, lx + lw / 2 + 14, lw / 2 - 18, .35, 2.4, { noShutter: true, panes: 2, frame: '#5e676f', lit: true, seed: 6 });
          door(c, F, lx + lw / 2 - 10, 20, 2.1, { leaves: 2, inside: function (cc, x, y, w, h) { R(cc, N ? 'rgba(255,240,200,.6)' : 'rgba(220,214,200,.55)', x, y + h * .5, w, h * .5); } });
          canopy(c, F, lx + lw / 2 - 22, 44, 3.05, 1.2, '#6c757c', { glassTop: true, lights: true }); textSign(c, lx + lw / 2 + 28, Y(F, 2.9), o.no || '12', 3.6, '#2f4a6a', '#ffffff', N);
        }
        downpipe(c, F, x0 + 1.5, F.h); downpipe(c, F, x1 - 2.7, F.h); if (!o.tile) band(c, F, x0, x1, F.h - .25, .45, rnd ? '#ffffff' : '#f4efe4');
      },
      ground: function (c, foot, rot, N, ph) { var Wf = foot[0], Df = foot[1], s = function (v) { return scl(Wf, v); };
        if (!ph) { paving(c, 0, Df, Wf, 16, N); return; }
        for (var i = 0; i < Wf / 55; i++) E(c, 14 + i * 55, Df + 24, 6, 3.6, N ? '#22392a' : '#5d9447');
        if (rot === 0) { planter(c, s(100), Df + 13, 24, N); planter(c, s(196), Df + 13, 24, N); bikeRack(c, s(30), Df + 12, 5, N); bins(c, Math.min(s(262), Wf - 30), Df + 13, N); bench(c, s(62), Df + 14, N); }
        else { bench(c, s(120), Df + 13, N); bench(c, s(200), Df + 13, N); tree(c, s(40), Df + 22, 9, N); tree(c, s(280), Df + 22, 10, N); bins(c, s(150), Df + 12, N); }
      }
    };
  }

  function aptxType(o) {

      wall: function (c, F, m, side) { if (m.part !== 'mid') return base.wall(c, F, m, side);

      ground: function (c, foot, rot, N, ph) { if (!ph) { paving(c, 0, foot[1] - 20, foot[0], 20, N); } base.ground(c, foot, rot, N, ph); }
    });

  function marketType(o) {

  function garageType(o) {
    var W = o.W, D = o.D, H = o.H || 3.4, n = o.n, rnd = o.mat !== 'stone';
    return {
      he: o.he, use: 'res', W: W, D: D, floors: 1, q: .45,
      masses: function () { return [{ x: 0, y: 0, w: W, d: D, h: H, main: true }]; },
      roof: function (c, Rc, h, m, N) { if (o.glass) { c.save(); c.globalAlpha = .34; }     flatRoof(c, Rc, h, { night: N, col: o.roofCol || '#cfcac0', rim: '#ece6da', parapet: .5 }); if (o.glass) c.restore();
        if (o.pv) pvArray(c, Rc[0] + 8, Rc[1] + 8, h, Math.max(1, Math.floor((Rc[2] - Rc[0] - 16) / 11)), Math.max(1, Math.floor((Rc[3] - Rc[1] - 16) / 9)), N); },
      wall: function (c, F, m, side) { var x0 = F.x0, x1 = F.x1, Wx = x1 - x0, N = F.night, col = side === 'S' ? o.wall : mix(o.wall, '#a89c86', .1);
        if (rnd) MAT.render(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, col); else MAT.stone(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, col);
        band(c, F, x0, x1, F.h - .25, .3, '#fbf8f1');
        if (side !== 'S') { win(c, F, x0 + Wx * .5 - 5, 10, 1.3, .9, { noShutter: true, seed: 3 }); door(c, F, x0 + Wx * .5 + 9, 10, 2.1, { frame: '#3d464d' }); return; }    
        if (o.sign) textSign(c, x0 + Wx * .5, Y(F, H - .5), o.sign, 2.4, o.signBg || '#1f4f7a', '#ffffff', N);
        var dw = o.dw || 26, gap = (Wx - n * dw) / (n + 1), hz = o.hz || 2.3, hp = hz * M * K;   
        for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) { var bx = x0 + gap + i * (dw + gap);
          R(c, N ? '#1d232a' : '#4a4f55', bx - 1, Y(F, hz + .1), dw + 2, (hz + .1) * M * K);
          R(c, N ? '#4b545e' : (o.door || '#c9ccc9'), bx, Y(F, hz), dw, hp);
          for (var k = 1; k < 8; k++) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.13)', bx, Y(F, hz) + k * hp / 8, dw, .35);
          if (N) R(c, 'rgba(255,236,190,.18)', bx, Y(F, .4), dw, .4 * M * K); }
        R(c, N ? '#fff3c4' : '#d8d4c8', x0 + Wx - 6, Y(F, 2.6), 1.2, 1.5); },
      ground: function (c, foot, rot, N, ph) { if (rot !== 0 || ph) return; paving(c, 0, foot[1], foot[0], 12, N, '#cfc8ba'); }
    };
  }
  function studioType(o) {

        MAT.render(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, side === 'S' ? '#f4f2ec' : '#e6e3dc');

      ground: function (c, foot, rot, N, ph) { if (rot !== 0) return; if (!ph) { deck(c, 0, foot[1], foot[0], 16, N); return; } plantPot(c, 8, foot[1] + 8, .5); plantPot(c, foot[0] - 10, foot[1] + 8, .5); }

  function hangarType(o) {

      wall: function (c, F, m, side) { var x0 = F.x0, x1 = F.x1, Wx = x1 - x0, N = F.night;
        MAT.metal(c, F, x0, x1, 0, F.h, side === 'S' ? '#dfe3e5' : '#cfd4d7');
        if (side !== 'S') { band(c, F, x0, x1, F.h - .5, .3, '#2f5f9e'); door(c, F, x0 + Wx * .5 - 5, 10, 2.1, { frame: '#3d464d' }); return; }    
        var dx = x0 + Wx * .06, dw = Wx * .88, hz = 5.2;
        R(c, N ? '#0f1318' : '#2b3036', dx, Y(F, hz), dw, hz * M * K);                                   
        R(c, N ? '#3d444b' : '#aab2b8', dx, Y(F, hz), dw * .5, hz * M * K);                              
        for (var k = 1; k < 6; k++) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.12)', dx + k * dw * .5 / 6, Y(F, hz), .4, hz * M * K);

      ground: function (c, foot, rot, N, ph) { if (rot !== 0 || ph) return; R(c, N ? '#2a2f35' : '#a8acae', 0, foot[1], foot[0], 30); for (var x = 4; x < foot[0]; x += 14) R(c, 'rgba(242,194,48,.8)', x, foot[1] + 14, 7, 1.2); }
    };
  }

  function brandPlate(c, F, cx, z, name, key, o) {
    o = o || {}; var y = Y(F, z), fs = o.fs || 9, h = fs * 1.6, col = LOGO_COL[key] || ['#2f363c', '#ffffff'];
    c.font = '800 ' + fs + 'px ' + SANS; var tw = c.measureText(name).width, lw = h * .92, w = tw + lw + fs * 1.2, x0 = cx - w / 2, y0 = y - h / 2;
    if (F.night) R(c, rg(c, cx, y, w * .8, ['rgba(255,236,190,.32)', 'rgba(255,236,190,0)']), cx - w, y - h * 2, w * 2, h * 4);
    R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.3)', x0 + 1, y0 + 1.4, w, h);
    RR(c, x0, y0, w, h, 2, F.night ? sh(col[0], .12) : col[0]); R(c, 'rgba(255,255,255,.14)', x0 + 1, y0 + .8, w - 2, h * .3);
    R(c, col[1], x0 + 2, y0 + h - 2.2, w - 4, 1.2);
    c.fillStyle = col[1]; c.textAlign = 'center'; c.textBaseline = 'middle'; c.direction = 'rtl'; c.fillText(name, x0 + fs * .5 + tw / 2, y0 + h * .5);
    var lx = x0 + w - lw - fs * .25, ly = y0 + (h - lw) / 2;
    if (LOGO[key]) c.drawImage(LOGO[key], lx, ly, lw, lw); else { E(c, lx + lw / 2, ly + lw / 2, lw / 2, lw / 2, col[1]); }
  }
  
  function dockDoor(c, F, x, w, open, N) {
    var z0 = 1.2, zt = 4.0, y0 = Y(F, zt + .25), y1 = Y(F, 0);
    R(c, N ? '#0e1114' : '#1d2125', x - 2.2, y0, w + 4.4, Y(F, z0 - .1) - y0);                                 
    if (open) { R(c, N ? '#2a2318' : '#3a342b', x, Y(F, zt), w, (zt - z0) * M * K); R(c, N ? 'rgba(255,214,140,.5)' : 'rgba(255,214,140,.18)', x + 2, Y(F, zt - .4), w - 4, (zt - z0 - .6) * M * K); }   
    else { R(c, N ? '#4c545c' : '#c4c9cc', x, Y(F, zt), w, (zt - z0) * M * K); for (var k = 1; k < 7; k++) R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.14)', x, Y(F, zt) + k * (zt - z0) * M * K / 7, w, .4); }
    R(c, '#2a2d30', x + 2, Y(F, z0 - .1), 3, .5 * M * K); R(c, '#2a2d30', x + w - 5, Y(F, z0 - .1), 3, .5 * M * K);      
    for (var i = 0; i < 4; i++) { R(c, i % 2 ? '#1d1f22' : '#f2c230', x - 2.2, Y(F, z0) + i * 1.1, 1.4, 1.1); R(c, i % 2 ? '#1d1f22' : '#f2c230', x + w + .8, Y(F, z0) + i * 1.1, 1.4, 1.1); }
    R(c, '#6b7176', x - .5, Y(F, z0), w + 1, .8);                                                                   
    R(c, N ? '#ffe9a8' : '#9aa1a6', x + w / 2 - 1.5, Y(F, zt + .6), 3, 1.2);                                      
  }
  function hazardStripe(c, F, x0, x1, z) { for (var x = x0; x < x1; x += 4) R(c, ((x - x0) / 4) % 2 < 1 ? '#f2c230' : '#2a2d30', x, Y(F, z + .35), 4, .35 * M * K); }
  function whType(o) {
    var W = o.W, D = o.D, H = o.H || 8;
    return {

  function civicType(o) {
    var W = o.W, D = o.D, nf = o.nf, gh = o.gh || 4.2, fh = o.fh || 3.6, H = gh + (nf - 1) * fh + .8, zf = function (f) { return f ? gh + (f - 1) * fh : 0; }, A = o.accent || '#2f4a6a';

  function rotRect(r, W, D, m) { var x = m.x, y = m.y, w = m.w, d = m.d, Q;
    if (r === 0) Q = [x, y, w, d]; else if (r === 2) Q = [W - x - w, D - y - d, w, d]; else if (r === 1) Q = [D - y - d, x, d, w]; else Q = [y, W - x - w, d, w];
    return [Q[0] * M, Q[1] * M, (Q[0] + Q[2]) * M, (Q[1] + Q[3]) * M]; }
  var SIDE = ['S', 'E', 'N', 'W'];   
  function model(id, rot) { var T = TYPES[id]; if (!T) throw new Error('BLD40: unknown type ' + id);
    var ms = T.masses().map(function (m, i) { return Object.assign({ i: i, R: rotRect(rot, T.W, T.D, m) }, m); });
    var fw = rot & 1 ? T.D : T.W, fd = rot & 1 ? T.W : T.D, H = Math.max.apply(null, ms.map(function (m) { return m.h + (m.ridge || 0); }));
    var q = T.q || API.Q, yS = fd * M; ms.forEach(function (m) { m.R = [m.R[0], yS - q * (yS - m.R[1]), m.R[2], yS - q * (yS - m.R[3])]; }); QY = q;    
    return { T: T, rot: rot, ms: ms, foot: [fw * M, fd * M], H: H }; }
  function render(c, Mo, N) {
    var T = Mo.T, rot = Mo.rot, side = SIDE[rot];
    if (T.ground) T.ground(c, Mo.foot, rot, N, 0);
    c.save(); c.fillStyle = N ? 'rgba(4,8,14,.25)' : 'rgba(14,20,28,.30)'; c.beginPath();                
    Mo.ms.forEach(function (m) { if (!m.roofRoom) shadowBox(c, m.R[0], m.R[1], m.R[2], m.R[3], m.h + (m.ridge || 0) * .6, 0); }); c.fill('nonzero'); c.restore();
    var host = Mo.ms.filter(function (m) { return m.main; })[0] || Mo.ms[0];
    Mo.ms.filter(function (m) { return !m.roofRoom; }).sort(function (a, b) { return a.R[3] - b.R[3] || a.h - b.h; }).forEach(function (m) {
      var Rc = m.R, F = { x0: Rc[0], x1: Rc[2], yb: Rc[3], h: m.h, seed: m.i * 7 + rot + 1, night: N };
      if (m.tile) { T.wall(c, F, m, side); T.roof(c, Rc, m.h, m, N); } else { T.roof(c, Rc, m.h, m, N); T.wall(c, F, m, side); }
      R(c, 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)', Rc[0], F.yb - .8, Rc[2] - Rc[0], .8);
    });
    Mo.ms.filter(function (m) { return m.roofRoom; }).forEach(function (m) { var Rc = m.R; T.roofRoom(c, Rc[0], Rc[1], Rc[2] - Rc[0], Rc[3] - Rc[1], host.h, m.h - host.h, N); });
    if (T.ground) T.ground(c, Mo.foot, rot, N, 1);
  }
  function extents(Mo) { var x0 = -8, y0 = 0, x1 = Mo.foot[0] + 8, y1 = Mo.foot[1] + 40;
    Mo.ms.forEach(function (m) { var Rc = m.R, hz = (m.h + (m.ridge || 0) + 3) * M; y0 = Math.min(y0, Rc[1] - hz * K - 18); x1 = Math.max(x1, Rc[2] + SX * m.h * M + 6); y1 = Math.max(y1, Rc[3] + SY * m.h * M + 6); });
    return [Math.floor(x0), Math.floor(y0), Math.ceil(x1), Math.ceil(y1)]; }
  var CACHE = new Map(), BYTES = 0, STATS = { made: 0, ms: 0, evicted: 0 }, QY = 1;
  function qy(y, Df) { return y >= Df ? y : Df - QY * (Df - y); }   
  function cacheGet(k) { var e = CACHE.get(k); if (e) { CACHE.delete(k); CACHE.set(k, e); } return e; }
  function cachePut(k, e) { CACHE.set(k, e); BYTES += e.bytes; var cap = API.budgetMB * 1048576; while (BYTES > cap && CACHE.size > 1) { var k0 = CACHE.keys().next().value; if (k0 === k) break; BYTES -= CACHE.get(k0).bytes; CACHE.delete(k0); STATS.evicted++; } }
  var API = {
    version: VERSION, K: K, SUN: { x: SX, y: SY }, budgetMB: 24, skyLit: false, Q: .55,
    types: function () { return Object.keys(TYPES).map(function (k) { var T = TYPES[k]; return { id: k, he: T.he, use: T.use, W: T.W, D: T.D, floors: T.floors }; }); },
    info: function (id) { var Mo = model(id, 0); return { id: id, he: Mo.T.he, W: Mo.T.W, D: Mo.T.D, H: Mo.H, floors: Mo.T.floors }; },
    ready: function () { return LOGO_N >= Object.keys(LOGO_SVG).length; },
    make: function (id, rot, res, night) {
      rot = rot | 0; res = res || 2; night = !!night; var key = id + '|' + rot + '|' + res + '|' + (night ? 1 : 0) + '|' + (API.ready() ? 1 : 0), e = cacheGet(key); if (e) return e;   
      var t0 = (typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : 0), Mo = model(id, rot), X = extents(Mo), w = X[2] - X[0], h = X[3] - X[1];

      e = { cv: cv, ox: -X[0], oy: -X[1], w: w, h: h, res: res, bytes: cv.width * cv.height * 4, H: Mo.H, foot: Mo.foot };
      STATS.made++; STATS.ms += (typeof performance !== 'undefined' ? performance.now() : 0) - t0; cachePut(key, e); return e;
    },
    draw: function (ctx, x, y, id, rot, res, night) { var e = API.make(id, rot, res, night); ctx.drawImage(e.cv, x - e.ox, y - e.oy, e.w, e.h); return e; },
     
    signAudit: function (list) { var out = [];

        } catch (e) { SIGNQA.on = false; out.push({ id: q.id, zone: q.zone, type: q.type, err: String(e && e.message || e) }); } }); });
      return out; },
    band: function (id, rot) { var Mo = model(id, rot | 0), d = Math.max.apply(null, Mo.ms.map(function (m) { return K * (m.h + (m.ridge || 0)) * M + 5 - m.R[1]; }));     return [0, -d, Mo.foot[0], d]; },
    check: function (id, rot, x, y, rects) { var b = API.band(id, rot), B = [x + b[0], y + b[1], b[2], b[3]], hits = [];

      return { ok: !hits.length, band: B, hits: hits }; },
    stats: function () { return { pictures: CACHE.size, MB: +(BYTES / 1048576).toFixed(2), made: STATS.made, ms: +STATS.ms.toFixed(1), evicted: STATS.evicted, budgetMB: API.budgetMB }; },
    clear: function () { CACHE.clear(); BYTES = 0; }
  };

  function prism(ctx, P, z0, h, top, side) {
    var n = P.length, u0 = z0 * K6, u1 = (z0 + h) * K6, cx = 0, cy = 0, k;
    for (k = 0; k < n; k++) { cx += P[k][0] / n; cy += P[k][1] / n; }
    for (k = 0; k < n; k++) { var a = P[k], b = P[(k + 1) % n], mx = (a[0] + b[0]) / 2, my = (a[1] + b[1]) / 2, nx = b[1] - a[1], ny = a[0] - b[0];
      if (nx * (mx - cx) + ny * (my - cy) < 0) { nx = -nx; ny = -ny; }
      if (ny <= 0) continue;
      ctx.fillStyle = side; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a[0], a[1] - u0); ctx.lineTo(b[0], b[1] - u0); ctx.lineTo(b[0], b[1] - u1); ctx.lineTo(a[0], a[1] - u1); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); }
    ctx.fillStyle = top; ctx.beginPath(); for (k = 0; k < n; k++) ctx[k ? 'lineTo' : 'moveTo'](P[k][0], P[k][1] - u1); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); }
  function rectAt(f, r, w) { var dx = f[0] - r[0], dy = f[1] - r[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1, px = -dy / L * w / 2, py = dx / L * w / 2;   
    return [[f[0] + px, f[1] + py], [f[0] - px, f[1] - py], [r[0] - px, r[1] - py], [r[0] + px, r[1] + py]]; }
  function atLen(P, d) { var k, l, a, b;                                                              
    if (d <= 0) { a = P[0]; b = P[1]; l = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]) || 1; return [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) / l * d, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) / l * d]; }
    for (k = 0; k + 1 < P.length; k++) { a = P[k]; b = P[k + 1]; l = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]); if (d <= l) return [a[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) * d / l, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * d / l]; d -= l; }
    a = P[P.length - 2]; b = P[P.length - 1]; l = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]) || 1; return [b[0] + (b[0] - a[0]) / l * d, b[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) / l * d]; }
  function plen(P) { var s = 0; for (var k = 0; k + 1 < P.length; k++) s += Math.hypot(P[k + 1][0] - P[k][0], P[k + 1][1] - P[k][1]); return s; }
  function shadow(ctx, Q) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.22)'; ctx.beginPath(); Q.forEach(function (q, i) { ctx[i ? 'lineTo' : 'moveTo'](q[0] + 4, q[1] + 3); }); ctx.fill(); }
  
  function cyl34(ctx, f, r_, rad, z0, cols) {                                                         
    var dx = f[0] - r_[0], dy = f[1] - r_[1], L = Math.hypot(dx, dy) || 1, nx = -dy / L, ny = dx / L, F = [], k;
    for (k = 0; k < 12; k++) { var a0 = k / 12 * 6.2832, a1 = (k + 1) / 12 * 6.2832, am = (a0 + a1) / 2;
      F.push({ a0: a0, a1: a1, depth: Math.cos(am) * ny + Math.sin(am) * .9, lit: .55 + .45 * Math.max(0, Math.sin(am) * .8 + Math.cos(am) * .35 * (ny >= 0 ? 1 : -1)) }); }
    F.sort(function (p, q) { return p.depth - q.depth; });
    function P3(base, a) { var lat = Math.cos(a) * rad, h = (z0 + rad / 10 + Math.sin(a) * rad / 10) * K6; return [base[0] + nx * lat, base[1] + ny * lat - h]; }
    F.forEach(function (q) { var A = P3(f, q.a0), B = P3(f, q.a1), C = P3(r_, q.a1), D = P3(r_, q.a0), c = Math.round(150 + 105 * q.lit);
      ctx.fillStyle = cols ? cols(q.lit) : 'rgb(' + c + ',' + (c + 3) + ',' + (c + 6) + ')'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(A[0], A[1]); ctx.lineTo(B[0], B[1]); ctx.lineTo(C[0], C[1]); ctx.lineTo(D[0], D[1]); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); });
    var E = []; for (k = 0; k <= 16; k++) E.push(P3(f, k / 16 * 6.2832)); ctx.fillStyle = '#d9dee2'; ctx.beginPath(); E.forEach(function (q, i) { ctx[i ? 'lineTo' : 'moveTo'](q[0], q[1]); }); ctx.fill(); }   
  function tanker34(ctx, P, s, N, hose, t, lid) {
    var cf = atLen(P, s), tr = atLen(P, s - 110), mid = atLen(P, s - 55), hd = Math.atan2(cf[1] - tr[1], cf[0] - tr[0]);
    if (hose) { var h = atLen(P, s - 70); ctx.strokeStyle = '#1f2326'; ctx.lineWidth = 2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(h[0], h[1] - 1.2 * K6); ctx.quadraticCurveTo((h[0] + lid[0]) / 2, Math.max(h[1], lid[1]) + 8, lid[0], lid[1]); ctx.stroke();
      ctx.fillStyle = (Math.floor(t * 2) % 2) ? '#ffb000' : '#7a5400'; ctx.fillRect(h[0] - 2, h[1] - 1.2 * K6 - 2, 4, 4); }
    if (LIVEQ && window.D3INGAME) { PENDING.push(['TANKER', mid[0], mid[1], hd]); return; }                 
    shadow(ctx, rectAt(cf, tr, 25));
    function body() { prism(ctx, rectAt(atLen(P, s - 26), tr, 21), .3, .9, '#2b2f33', '#1f2326'); cyl34(ctx, atLen(P, s - 29), atLen(P, s - 108), 12, 1.1); var u = 3.5 * K6, a = atLen(P, s - 34), b = atLen(P, s - 104);
      ctx.strokeStyle = '#b5352b'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.5; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(a[0], a[1] - u + 1); ctx.lineTo(b[0], b[1] - u + 1); ctx.stroke(); }
    function cab() { prism(ctx, rectAt(cf, atLen(P, s - 25), 25), .5, 2.6, '#c0392b', '#94291f'); var W = rectAt(atLen(P, s - 2), atLen(P, s - 8), 23); ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#9fd8ff' : '#2b3a44'; ctx.beginPath(); W.forEach(function (q, i) { ctx[i ? 'lineTo' : 'moveTo'](q[0], q[1] - 3.1 * K6); }); ctx.fill(); }
    if (cf[1] < tr[1]) { cab(); body(); } else { body(); cab(); } }
  function along(P, f) { var L = [], tot = 0; for (var k = 0; k + 1 < P.length; k++) { var l = Math.hypot(P[k + 1][0] - P[k][0], P[k + 1][1] - P[k][1]); L.push(l); tot += l; }
    var d = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, f)) * tot, q = 0; while (q < L.length - 1 && d > L[q]) { d -= L[q]; q++; } var A = P[q], B = P[q + 1], u = L[q] ? d / L[q] : 0;
    return [A[0] + (B[0] - A[0]) * u, A[1] + (B[1] - A[1]) * u, Math.atan2(B[1] - A[1], B[0] - A[0])]; }
  function alongT(P, TT, u) { var k = 0; while (k < TT.length - 2 && u > TT[k + 1]) k++;           
    var A = P[k], B = P[k + 1], f = TT[k + 1] > TT[k] ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (u - TT[k]) / (TT[k + 1] - TT[k]))) : 1; return [A[0] + (B[0] - A[0]) * f, A[1] + (B[1] - A[1]) * f, Math.atan2(B[1] - A[1], B[0] - A[0])]; }
  function ease(u) { return u < 0 ? 0 : u > 1 ? 1 : u * u * (3 - 2 * u); }
  function loopAlong(P, d) { var seg = [], per = 0; for (var k = 0; k < P.length; k++) { var a = P[k], b = P[(k + 1) % P.length], l = Math.hypot(b[0] - a[0], b[1] - a[1]); seg.push([a, b, l]); per += l; }
    d = d % per; var q = 0; while (d > seg[q][2]) { d -= seg[q][2]; q++; } var A = seg[q][0], B = seg[q][1], f = d / seg[q][2]; return [A[0] + (B[0] - A[0]) * f, A[1] + (B[1] - A[1]) * f, Math.atan2(B[1] - A[1], B[0] - A[0])]; }
  function showRow(ctx, D, N) { (D.display_cars || []).forEach(function (q, i) { if (q.hide) return; car(ctx, q[0], q[1], q.length > 2 ? q[2] : (i % 2 ? .32 : -.32), N, q.asset || ['VH-SU-03', 'VH-SP-02', 'VH-SD-04', 'VH-PK-02'][i % 4], 0, q.color != null ? q.color : [1, 6, 2, 7][i % 4]); }); }        
  function live(ctx, D, now, N) { var t = (now || 0) / 1000, RES = window.D3RES || 2;

      for (var y = p[1] + 4; y < p[3]; y += 7) { ctx.beginPath(); for (var x = p[0]; x <= p[2]; x += 6) { var yy = y + Math.sin(x * .09 + t * 2.1 + i + y) * 1.4; x === p[0] ? ctx.moveTo(x, yy) : ctx.lineTo(x, yy); } ctx.stroke(); }
      ctx.restore(); });
    var F = D.fuel;
    if (F) { var T = t % (F.cycle || 120);

      if (!F.full) { F.full = F.tIn.concat(F.tOut.slice(1)); F.l1 = plen(F.tIn); F.l2 = plen(F.full); }
      if (T < TE && !window.FUEL_REAL) { var s, hose = false, FULL = F.full;

        else { var u1 = (T - TK.t_in - TK.dwell) / TK.t_out; s = F.l1 + (F.l2 - F.l1) * u1 * u1; }     
        ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, T / 1.5, (TE - T) / 1.5)); tanker34(ctx, FULL, s, N, hose, t, F.lids[1]); ctx.restore(); }
      (window.FUEL_REAL ? [] : (F.trips || [])).forEach(function (q, qi) { var u = T - q.t0, ti = q.inT ? q.inT[q.inT.length - 1] : 7, to = q.outT ? q.outT[q.outT.length - 1] : 8; if (u < 0 || u > ti + q.dwell + to) return; var p, an; if (window.D3BUSY && D3BUSY(qi)) return;
        ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, u / 1.2, (ti + q.dwell + to - u) / 1.2));
        if (u < ti) { p = q.inT ? alongT(q.inP, q.inT, u) : along(q.inP, ease(u / ti)); an = p[2]; } else if (u < ti + q.dwell) { p = along(q.inP, 1); an = q.a; } else { p = q.outT ? alongT(q.outP, q.outT, u - ti - q.dwell) : along(q.outP, ease((u - ti - q.dwell) / to)); an = p[2]; }
        car(ctx, p[0], p[1], an, N, q.car, 0, q.col);
        if (u >= ti + 1 && u < ti + q.dwell - 1) { var pu = null, bd = 1e9; F.pumps.forEach(function (m) { var d = Math.hypot(m[0] - p[0], m[1] - p[1]); if (d < bd) { bd = d; pu = m; } });   
          ctx.strokeStyle = '#1f2326'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(pu[0], pu[1] - 6); ctx.quadraticCurveTo((pu[0] + p[0]) / 2, pu[1] - 14, p[0] + 6, p[1] - 4); ctx.stroke(); } ctx.restore(); });
      var roofF = function (ctx) { var C = F.canopy, h = 5.0 * K6; ctx.save(); ctx.globalAlpha = .62;                                
      ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#d9dde0' : '#f4f6f7'; ctx.fillRect(C[0], C[1] - h, C[2] - C[0], C[3] - C[1]); ctx.globalAlpha = 1;
      var BR = F.brand; ctx.fillStyle = BR ? BR.c1 : '#b5352b'; ctx.fillRect(C[0], C[3] - h - 2, C[2] - C[0], 7); ctx.fillStyle = BR ? BR.c2 : '#ffffff'; ctx.font = '700 6px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.fillText(BR ? BR.name : 'דלק', (C[0] + C[2]) / 2, C[3] - h + 3.6);    
      if (N) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,248,214,.16)'; ctx.fillRect(C[0] - 10, C[1] - 6, C[2] - C[0] + 20, C[3] - C[1] + 16); }
      ctx.restore(); };
      if (LIVEQ && window.D3INGAME) { if (ROOFQ.length > 8) ROOFQ.shift(); ROOFQ.push([ctx, roofF]); } else roofF(ctx); }    
    var TT = D.turntable;
    if (TT) { var an = t * .22; ctx.save(); ctx.translate(TT.c[0], TT.c[1]); ctx.rotate(an); ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(80,86,92,.5)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
        for (var k = 0; k < 6; k++) { ctx.rotate(Math.PI / 6); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(-TT.r + 2, 0); ctx.lineTo(TT.r - 2, 0); ctx.stroke(); } ctx.restore();

      while (da > Math.PI) da -= TAU; while (da < -Math.PI) da += TAU; for (var k = 0; k <= 6; k++) { var aa = a0 + da * k / 6; pts.push([cx + Math.cos(aa) * r, cy + Math.sin(aa) * r]); } }
    pts.push(pts[0].slice()); var cuLen = [0]; for (var j = 1; j < pts.length; j++) cuLen.push(cuLen[j - 1] + Math.hypot(pts[j][0] - pts[j - 1][0], pts[j][1] - pts[j - 1][1]));

  function vanAt(t) { var V = M5.van, P = vanPath(), Tt = P.L / V.v, T = Tt, i, s = 0, mv = 1; for (i = 0; i < V.stops.length; i++) T += V.stops[i][1];

      if (u <= dur || i === P.segs.length - 1) { if (g[0]) { s = g[1] * P.L; mv = 0; } else { var f = Math.min(1, u / Math.max(1e-6, dur)); f = f * f * (3 - 2 * f); s = (g[1] + (g[2] - g[1]) * f) * P.L; } break; } u -= dur; }
    var j = 1; while (j < P.cuLen.length - 1 && P.cuLen[j] < s) j++; var a = P.pts[j - 1], b = P.pts[j], ff = (s - P.cuLen[j - 1]) / Math.max(1e-6, P.cuLen[j] - P.cuLen[j - 1]);

    ctx.fillStyle = front; ctx.fillRect(x0, y1 - H, x1 - x0, H); ctx.fillStyle = top; ctx.fillRect(x0, y0 - H, x1 - x0, y1 - y0);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.28)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; ctx.strokeRect(x0 + .5, y0 - H + .5, x1 - x0 - 1, y1 - y0 - 1); ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.18)'; ctx.fillRect(x0, y1 - H - 1, x1 - x0, 1); return H; }
  function windows(ctx, x0, x1, yb, zm, rows, N, lit, w, gap) { w = w || 5; gap = gap || 4; for (var r = 0; r < rows; r++) { var y = yb - (r + .45) * (zm / rows) * K - 3;
      for (var x = x0 + 4; x + w < x1 - 3; x += w + gap) { ctx.fillStyle = N ? (lit && ((x * 7 + r * 13) % 5 < 3) ? '#ffd98a' : '#1c2430') : '#3d5466'; ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, 4); ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255,255,255,.25)'; if (!N) ctx.fillRect(x, y, w, 1); } } }
  
  function cyl3(ctx, cx, cy, r, zm, shell, dark, roof, o) { o = o || {}; var H = zm * K; if (!o.noShadow) shadowCyl(ctx, cx, cy, r, zm);
    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(cx - r, 0, cx + r, 0); g.addColorStop(0, shell); g.addColorStop(.55, shell); g.addColorStop(1, dark); ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx - r, cy - H); ctx.lineTo(cx - r, cy); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, r, r * .5, 0, Math.PI, 0, true); ctx.lineTo(cx + r, cy - H); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    ctx.fillStyle = roof || shell; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy - H, r, r * .5, 0, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)'; ctx.lineWidth = .8; ctx.stroke(); return H; }
  function ring(ctx, cx, cy, rx, col, w) { ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = w || 1; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, cy, rx, rx * .5, 0, 0, Math.PI); ctx.stroke(); }
  function rail(ctx, cx, ytop, rx, N) {   
    ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#7a6a2a' : '#e0b73a'; ctx.lineWidth = .9; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(cx, ytop - 5, rx, rx * .5, 0, 0, Math.PI); ctx.stroke();
    for (var a = .15; a < Math.PI; a += .35) { var x = cx + Math.cos(a) * rx, y = ytop + Math.sin(a) * rx * .5; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x, y - 5); ctx.stroke(); } }
  function ladder(ctx, x, yb, yt, N) { ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#6b6f73' : '#4a4f54'; ctx.lineWidth = .8; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - 1.6, yb); ctx.lineTo(x - 1.6, yt); ctx.moveTo(x + 1.6, yb); ctx.lineTo(x + 1.6, yt);
    for (var y = yb - 2; y > yt; y -= 2.6) { ctx.moveTo(x - 1.6, y); ctx.lineTo(x + 1.6, y); } ctx.stroke();
    ctx.lineWidth = .6; for (var y2 = yb - 14; y2 > yt + 2; y2 -= 6) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(x, y2, 3.4, Math.PI * .1, Math.PI * .9, true); ctx.stroke(); } }   
  function stairsOn(ctx, cx, cy, r, H, N) {   
    ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#5d6064' : '#5b6167'; ctx.lineWidth = 2.2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + r * .92, cy + r * .2); ctx.lineTo(cx - r * .55, cy - H + r * .42); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#8a7a3a' : '#e0b73a'; ctx.lineWidth = .8; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx + r * .92, cy + r * .2 - 5); ctx.lineTo(cx - r * .55, cy - H + r * .42 - 5); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.35)'; ctx.lineWidth = .6; for (var k = 0; k < 1; k += .06) { var x = cx + r * .92 + (cx - r * .55 - cx - r * .92) * k, y = cy + r * .2 + (cy - H + r * .42 - cy - r * .2) * k; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - 1.4, y); ctx.lineTo(x + 1.4, y); ctx.stroke(); } }
  function label(ctx, t, x, y, fs, col) { ctx.save(); ctx.font = '700 ' + fs + 'px Arial'; ctx.textAlign = 'center'; ctx.textBaseline = 'middle'; ctx.direction = 'rtl'; ctx.fillStyle = col; ctx.fillText(t, x, y); ctx.restore(); }
  function hdrum(ctx, x0, x1, cy, r, zm, shell, dark, N) {   
    var yc = cy - zm * K; shadowBox(ctx, x0, cy - r, x1, cy + r * .4, zm + r / 10); ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#3b3e42' : '#6b7075'; [x0 + 6, x1 - 10].forEach(function (x) { ctx.fillRect(x, yc + r * .6, 4, cy - yc - r * .6 + 1); });
    var g = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, yc - r, 0, yc + r); g.addColorStop(0, shell); g.addColorStop(1, dark); ctx.fillStyle = g; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0 + r * .5, yc - r); ctx.lineTo(x1 - r * .5, yc - r);
    ctx.ellipse(x1 - r * .5, yc, r * .5, r, 0, -Math.PI / 2, Math.PI / 2); ctx.lineTo(x0 + r * .5, yc + r); ctx.ellipse(x0 + r * .5, yc, r * .5, r, 0, Math.PI / 2, Math.PI * 1.5); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)'; ctx.lineWidth = .8; ctx.stroke(); }
  function pipeLine(ctx, pts, zm, col, w) { ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = w || 1.6; ctx.beginPath(); pts.forEach(function (p, i) { var y = p[1] - (p[2] != null ? p[2] : zm) * K; i ? ctx.lineTo(p[0], y) : ctx.moveTo(p[0], y); }); ctx.stroke(); }
  var PIPES = [['#9aa1a6', '#4a4e52'], ['#d9b43a', '#7a6624'], ['#b8392f', '#5e2420'], ['#4f8f6a', '#2e5340']];
  
  function rack(ctx, R, N) { var a = R.a, b = R.b, hz = R.h, H = hz * K, w = R.w, hor = Math.abs(b[0] - a[0]) > Math.abs(b[1] - a[1]), L = hor ? b[0] - a[0] : b[1] - a[1], n = Math.max(1, Math.round(L / 40));
    if (!NOSH) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,16,24,.16)'; if (hor) ctx.fillRect(a[0] + 2.5 * hz, a[1] - w / 2 + 3.2 * hz, L, w); else ctx.fillRect(a[0] - w / 2 + 2.5 * hz, a[1] + 3.2 * hz, w, L); }
    for (var i = 0; i <= n; i++) { var x = hor ? a[0] + L * i / n : a[0], y = hor ? a[1] : a[1] + L * i / n; ctx.fillStyle = c('steelD', N);
      if (hor) { ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y - w / 2 - H, 2, H); ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y + w / 2 - H, 2, H); ctx.fillRect(x - 1, y - w / 2 - H, 2, w); } else { ctx.fillRect(x - w / 2 - 1, y - H, 2, H); ctx.fillRect(x + w / 2 - 1, y - H, 2, H); ctx.fillRect(x - w / 2, y - H - 1, w, 2); } }
    for (var p = 0; p < 4; p++) { var off = -w / 2 + 2 + p * (w - 4) / 3; ctx.strokeStyle = PIPES[p][N ? 1 : 0]; ctx.lineWidth = p === 0 ? 2.4 : 1.7; ctx.beginPath();
      if (hor) { ctx.moveTo(a[0], a[1] + off - H - 1.5); ctx.lineTo(b[0], b[1] + off - H - 1.5); } else { ctx.moveTo(a[0] + off, a[1] - H - 1.5); ctx.lineTo(b[0] + off, b[1] - H - 1.5); } ctx.stroke(); } }
  
  function fenceRun(ctx, x0, y0, x1, y1, N, gaps) { var hor = Math.abs(x1 - x0) > Math.abs(y1 - y0), H = 2.4 * K, inGap = function (v) { return (gaps || []).some(function (g) { return v > g[0] && v < g[1]; }); };
    if (hor) { var a = Math.min(x0, x1), b = Math.max(x0, x1); for (var x = a; x < b; x += 2) { if (inGap(x + 1)) continue; ctx.fillStyle = N ? 'rgba(120,128,132,.28)' : 'rgba(205,212,214,.42)'; ctx.fillRect(x, y0 - H, 2, H); }
      ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#5d6266' : '#6d7479'; ctx.lineWidth = 1; for (var x2 = a; x2 <= b; x2 += 30) { if (inGap(x2)) continue; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x2, y0); ctx.lineTo(x2, y0 - H - 2); ctx.stroke(); }
      ctx.lineWidth = .8; ctx.beginPath(); for (var s = a; s < b; s += 4) { if (inGap(s + 2)) continue; ctx.moveTo(s, y0 - H); ctx.lineTo(s + 4, y0 - H); ctx.moveTo(s, y0 - H - 2); ctx.lineTo(s + 2, y0 - H - 1.2); } ctx.stroke(); }
    else { var a2 = Math.min(y0, y1), b2 = Math.max(y0, y1); ctx.strokeStyle = N ? 'rgba(120,128,132,.6)' : 'rgba(150,158,162,.85)'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; ctx.beginPath();
      for (var y = a2; y < b2; y += 2) { if (inGap(y + 1)) continue; ctx.moveTo(x0, y); ctx.lineTo(x0, y + 2); } ctx.stroke(); ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#5d6266' : '#6d7479'; ctx.lineWidth = 1;
      for (var y3 = a2; y3 <= b2; y3 += 30) { if (inGap(y3)) continue; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y3); ctx.lineTo(x0, y3 - H - 2); ctx.stroke(); } } }
  function arm(ctx, x0, y0, x1, y1, z, N) { var H = z * K; ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#7e7a70' : '#e8e4da'; ctx.fillRect(x0 - 2.5, y0 - 9, 5, 9); ctx.lineWidth = 2.2;
    for (var k = 0; k < 6; k++) { ctx.strokeStyle = k % 2 ? (N ? '#8a8780' : '#f4f2ec') : (N ? '#6a2620' : '#d23b2f'); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0 + (x1 - x0) * k / 6, y0 - H + (y1 - y0) * k / 6); ctx.lineTo(x0 + (x1 - x0) * (k + 1) / 6, y0 - H + (y1 - y0) * (k + 1) / 6); ctx.stroke(); } }
  function stalls(ctx, list, N, col) { ctx.strokeStyle = col || c('line', N); ctx.lineWidth = 1.4; list.forEach(function (s) { var x = s[0], y = s[1], w = s[2], h = s[3]; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x, y + h); ctx.moveTo(x + w, y); ctx.lineTo(x + w, y + h); ctx.moveTo(x, y); ctx.lineTo(x + w, y); ctx.stroke(); }); }
  function arrow(ctx, x, y, a, N) { ctx.save(); ctx.translate(x, y); ctx.rotate(a); ctx.fillStyle = c('line', N); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(9, 0); ctx.lineTo(1, -5); ctx.lineTo(1, -2); ctx.lineTo(-9, -2); ctx.lineTo(-9, 2); ctx.lineTo(1, 2); ctx.lineTo(1, 5); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill(); ctx.restore(); }
  function dashed(ctx, x0, y0, x1, y1, col, w, d) { ctx.strokeStyle = col; ctx.lineWidth = w || 1.2; ctx.setLineDash(d || [8, 6]); ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x0, y0); ctx.lineTo(x1, y1); ctx.stroke(); ctx.setLineDash([]); }

  
  function groundRefinery(ctx, D, N) { var R = D.refinery, F = R.rect;
    ctx.fillStyle = c('asph', N); ctx.fillRect(F[0], F[1], F[2] - F[0], F[3] - F[1]);                                                     
    var B = R.bund.rect; ctx.fillStyle = c('bund', N); ctx.fillRect(B[0], B[1], B[2] - B[0], B[3] - B[1]);                                   
    var Pd = R.pad; ctx.fillStyle = c('pad', N); ctx.fillRect(Pd[0], Pd[1], Pd[2] - Pd[0], Pd[3] - Pd[1]);                                    
    ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.08)'; for (var x = Pd[0]; x < Pd[2]; x += 20) ctx.fillRect(x, Pd[1], .6, Pd[3] - Pd[1]); for (var y = Pd[1]; y < Pd[3]; y += 20) ctx.fillRect(Pd[0], y, Pd[2] - Pd[0], .6);
    [R.control.rect, R.cooling.rect, R.pumphouse.rect].forEach(function (r) { ctx.fillStyle = c('pad', N); ctx.fillRect(r[0] - 4, r[1] - 4, r[2] - r[0] + 8, r[3] - r[1] + 8); });
    var Cb = R.cooling.basin; ctx.fillStyle = c('conc', N); ctx.fillRect(Cb[0] - 2, Cb[1] - 1, Cb[2] - Cb[0] + 4, Cb[3] - Cb[1] + 3); ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#20404f' : '#3d7f9c'; ctx.fillRect(Cb[0], Cb[1], Cb[2] - Cb[0], Cb[3] - Cb[1]);
    
    R.roads.forEach(function (r) { var hor = (r[2] - r[0]) > (r[3] - r[1]); ctx.fillStyle = c('asphL', N); ctx.fillRect(r[0], r[1], r[2] - r[0], r[3] - r[1]);
      if (hor) { dashed(ctx, r[0], (r[1] + r[3]) / 2, r[2], (r[1] + r[3]) / 2, c('line', N)); ctx.fillStyle = c('yel', N); ctx.fillRect(r[0], r[1], r[2] - r[0], 1.2); ctx.fillRect(r[0], r[3] - 1.2, r[2] - r[0], 1.2); }
      else { dashed(ctx, (r[0] + r[2]) / 2, r[1], (r[0] + r[2]) / 2, r[3], c('line', N)); ctx.fillStyle = c('yel', N); ctx.fillRect(r[0], r[1], 1.2, r[3] - r[1]); ctx.fillRect(r[2] - 1.2, r[1], 1.2, r[3] - r[1]); } });
    ctx.fillStyle = c('line', N); ctx.fillRect(3016, 3826, 2.4, 33); label(ctx, 'עצור', 3002, 3851, 6, c('line', N));    
    var Cn = R.canopy.rect; ctx.fillStyle = c('pad', N); ctx.fillRect(Cn[0], Cn[1], Cn[2] - Cn[0], Cn[3] - Cn[1]);                          
    ctx.strokeStyle = c('yel', N); ctx.lineWidth = 1.6; ctx.strokeRect(R.canopy.truck - 18, Cn[1] + 6, 36, Cn[3] - Cn[1] - 12); ctx.strokeRect(2772, Cn[1] + 6, 36, Cn[3] - Cn[1] - 12);    
    if (R.pipe) pipeGround(ctx, D, N);    
    
    fenceRun(ctx, F[2], F[1], F[2], F[3], N, [[R.gate.open[0], R.gate.open[1]]]); fenceRun(ctx, F[0], F[1], F[0], F[3], N); }
  function tank(ctx, T, N) { var crude = T.kind === 'crude', H = cyl3(ctx, T.cx, T.cy, T.r, T.H, crude ? (N ? '#6d6a63' : '#e2ded2') : (N ? '#5f666b' : '#d4dde2'), N ? '#3c3a36' : '#9c988d', N ? '#57554f' : '#cfcbc0');
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.08)'; ctx.lineWidth = .7; for (var k = 1; k < 5; k++) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(T.cx, T.cy - H * k / 5, T.r, T.r * .5, 0, 0, Math.PI); ctx.stroke(); }   
    ctx.fillStyle = crude ? (N ? '#3a3631' : '#7d6c55') : (N ? '#2e3a42' : '#5d7d93'); ctx.fillRect(T.cx - T.r * .8, T.cy - H * .55, T.r * 1.6, 3);                                   
    label(ctx, T.id, T.cx - T.r * .25, T.cy - H * .3, 8, N ? '#9a978f' : '#4b4a45'); stairsOn(ctx, T.cx, T.cy, T.r, H, N); rail(ctx, T.cx, T.cy - H, T.r * .98, N);
    ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#4b4e52' : '#8d9399'; ctx.fillRect(T.cx + 4, T.cy - H - 5, 5, 4); ctx.fillRect(T.cx - 10, T.cy - H - 2, 4, 3);                                         
    pipeLine(ctx, [[T.cx + T.r * .4, T.cy + T.r * .35, .8], [T.cx + T.r * .4, T.cy + T.r * .5 + 30, .8]], 0, PIPES[0][N ? 1 : 0], 2.2); }
  function sphere(ctx, S, N) { var zc = 4.2, yc = S.cy - zc * K - S.r * .2; shadowCyl(ctx, S.cx, S.cy, S.r, 7);
    ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#3e4246' : '#7a8086'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.6; for (var i = 0; i < 6; i++) { var a = Math.PI * (i + .5) / 6, x = S.cx - S.r * Math.cos(a) * .95; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, S.cy + Math.sin(a) * 3); ctx.lineTo(x, yc + 2); ctx.stroke(); }
    var g = ctx.createRadialGradient(S.cx - S.r * .35, yc - S.r * .35, 2, S.cx, yc, S.r); g.addColorStop(0, N ? '#8a8a86' : '#ffffff'); g.addColorStop(1, N ? '#4a4a47' : '#bdbab1'); ctx.fillStyle = g;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(S.cx, yc, S.r, 0, TAU); ctx.fill(); ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.25)'; ctx.lineWidth = .8; ctx.stroke(); ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#7a6a2a' : '#e0b73a'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(S.cx + S.r, S.cy); ctx.lineTo(S.cx + 3, yc - S.r); ctx.stroke(); }
  function column(ctx, C, N) { var H = cyl3(ctx, C.cx, C.cy, C.r, C.H, N ? '#6f7377' : '#dfe3e5', N ? '#3c4044' : '#9aa1a6');
    ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#4a4844' : '#a8a397'; ctx.fillRect(C.cx - C.r, C.cy - 2 * K, 2 * C.r, 2 * K);                                                                      
    for (var z = 6; z < C.H - 1; z += 6) { var yp = C.cy - z * K; ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#4d5054' : '#8c9297'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.ellipse(C.cx, yp, C.r + 5, (C.r + 5) * .5, 0, 0, Math.PI); ctx.fill(); rail(ctx, C.cx, yp, C.r + 5, N); }   
    rail(ctx, C.cx, C.cy - H, C.r + 4, N); ladder(ctx, C.cx - C.r * .55, C.cy - 2 * K, C.cy - H - 4, N);
    ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#4a4e52' : '#5d6369'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(C.cx + C.r * .3, C.cy - H); ctx.lineTo(C.cx + C.r * .3, C.cy - H - 8); ctx.lineTo(C.cx + C.r * .3 + 7, C.cy - H - 8); ctx.stroke();   
    pipeLine(ctx, [[C.cx + C.r * .7, C.cy - H + 6, 0], [C.cx + C.r + 6, C.cy - H + 6, 0], [C.cx + C.r + 6, C.cy, 0]], 0, PIPES[0][N ? 1 : 0], 1.6);
    label(ctx, C.id, C.cx + C.r * .2, C.cy - H * .25, 7, N ? '#8f9396' : '#4b4f53'); }
  function heater(ctx, Hh, N) { var r = Hh.rect, H = box3(ctx, r[0], r[1], r[2], r[3], Hh.H, N ? '#4a3f3a' : '#7a6458', N ? '#3a302b' : '#8b4a33');
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,.22)'; ctx.lineWidth = .7; for (var x = r[0] + 4; x < r[2]; x += 4) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, r[3] - H); ctx.lineTo(x, r[3]); ctx.stroke(); }
    ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#3a2c26' : '#5d3426'; for (var x2 = r[0] + 6; x2 < r[2] - 4; x2 += 10) ctx.fillRect(x2, r[3] - 6, 5, 4);                                                    
    var S = Hh.stack; cyl3(ctx, S.cx, S.cy, S.r, S.H, N ? '#5d5a55' : '#a29c92', N ? '#3a3834' : '#6e6a62', '#2b2d30'); ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#6a2620' : '#c8352b'; ctx.fillRect(S.cx - S.r, S.cy - S.H * K + 4, 2 * S.r, 5); ctx.fillRect(S.cx - S.r, S.cy - S.H * K + 14, 2 * S.r, 5); }
  function flareStack(ctx, F, N) { var x = F.x, y = F.y, h = F.H * K; hdrum(ctx, F.drum[0], F.drum[2], F.drum[3], 6, 1.4, N ? '#6f7377' : '#d6dade', N ? '#3c4044' : '#959ca1', N); shadowPole(ctx, x, y, F.H, 2.5);
    ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(60,64,68,.55)'; ctx.lineWidth = .6; ctx.beginPath(); [[-12, 8], [14, 6], [0, 16]].forEach(function (g) { ctx.moveTo(x, y - h * .55); ctx.lineTo(x + g[0], y + g[1]); ctx.moveTo(x, y - h * .85); ctx.lineTo(x + g[0] * 1.4, y + g[1]); }); ctx.stroke();
    ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#5a5f63' : '#8d9398'; ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x - 3, y); ctx.lineTo(x - 1.6, y - h); ctx.lineTo(x + 1.6, y - h); ctx.lineTo(x + 3, y); ctx.closePath(); ctx.fill();
    for (var k = 0; k < 4; k++) { ctx.fillStyle = k % 2 ? '#f2f0ea' : '#c8352b'; ctx.fillRect(x - 1.9, y - h + 4 + k * 6, 3.8, 6); }
    ctx.fillStyle = '#4a4f54'; ctx.fillRect(x - 6, y - h + 30, 12, 1.6); ctx.fillRect(x - 6, y - h + 26, .8, 4); ctx.fillRect(x + 5.2, y - h + 26, .8, 4); ladder(ctx, x + 4.5, y - 6, y - h + 30, N); ctx.fillStyle = '#3a3e42'; ctx.fillRect(x - 2.4, y - h - 3, 4.8, 3.4); }
  function canopy(ctx, Cp, N, part) { var r = Cp.rect, H = Cp.H * K, cols = [r[0] + 3, (r[0] + r[2]) / 2, r[2] - 3];   
    if (part !== 'roof') {
    ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#55534e' : '#b3ad9f'; ctx.fillRect(2810, r[1] + 16, 22, r[3] - r[1] - 30); ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#46443f' : '#968f80'; ctx.fillRect(2810, r[3] - 14 - 1.2 * K, 22, 1.2 * K);   
    cols.forEach(function (x) { [r[1] + 4, r[3] - 4].forEach(function (y) { ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#4e5256' : '#7c8287'; ctx.fillRect(x - 1.5, y - H, 3, H); }); });
    if (!NOSH) { ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(10,16,24,.18)'; ctx.fillRect(r[0] + 2.5 * Cp.H, r[1] + 3.2 * Cp.H, r[2] - r[0], r[3] - r[1]); } }
    if (part === 'base') return;
    var ga = ctx.globalAlpha; ctx.globalAlpha = ga * .5; ctx.fillStyle = N ? '#5e5d58' : '#d9d6cc'; ctx.fillRect(r[0] - 4, r[1] - H - 4, r[2] - r[0] + 8, r[3] - r[1] + 4);   
    ctx.globalAlpha = ga * .7; ctx.strokeStyle = N ? '#3e3d39' : '#8d897e'; ctx.lineWidth = 1.2; for (var x2 = r[0]; x2 < r[2]; x2 += 24) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x2, r[1] - H - 4); ctx.lineTo(x2, r[3] - H); ctx.stroke(); }

function d5tkBox(v,x0,y0,x1,y1){return v.x>=x0&&v.x<=x1&&v.y>=y0&&v.y<=y1}
function d5tkGateClear(m,g){const mov=v=>Math.abs(v.speed||0)>3,all=[];for(const v of TRAFFIC_CARS)if(!v.parked)all.push(v);for(const v of BUS_VEHICLES)all.push(v);for(const v of a4FleetActors())if(v!==m)all.push(v);

function updateD5Tanker(dt){try{if(!D5TK.m)d5tkInit();if(!D5TK.holdFix)d5tkHoldFix();const m=D5TK.m,L=m.route;
  if(m.stopLeft>0){m.stopLeft-=dt;m.speed=0;m.stopEl=(m.stopEl||0)+dt;m.state={c:m.col,r:0,L:{lights:false}};if(m.stopLeft<=0){if(!d5tkMayGo(m))return;m.stopEl=0;m.leg=(m.leg+1)%m.legs.length;m.route=m.legs[m.leg];m.d=0;for(const h of m.route.holds)h.done=false;for(const g of m.route.gates)g.done=false}return}
  const v=(L.slow||L.rev)?18:m.vmax;
  let gw=null;for(const g of L.gates){if(g.done||m.d>g.d+.5||m.d+v*dt<g.d)continue;gw=d5tkGateClear(m,g);if(!gw){g.done=true;m.gateT=0;D5TK.gates++}break}
  if(gw){m.speed=0;m.gateT=(m.gateT||0)+dt;m.holdKind='gate';m.gateBy=gw;D5TK.maxGate=Math.max(D5TK.maxGate,m.gateT);m.state={c:m.col,r:0,L:{lights:false}};return}
  for(const h of L.holds){if(h.done||m.d>h.d+.5||m.d+v*dt<h.d)continue;let wait=false;try{const n=NODES2.get(h.node),mv=n&&n.movements.find(q=>q.id===h.mv);if(mv&&!SignalCore2.movementAllowed(mv,SignalCore2.phaseOf(h.node)))wait=true}catch(e){}
   if(!wait){const xb=d5tkExitBlocked(m,L,h);if(xb){m.holdKind='space';m.spaceBy=xb;m.speed=0;D5TK.spaceT=(D5TK.spaceT||0)+dt;m.state={c:m.col,r:0,L:{lights:false}};return}}    
   if(wait&&(m.holdT||0)<h.max){m.holdT=(m.holdT||0)+dt;m.holdKind='signal';m.speed=0;D5TK.maxHold=Math.max(D5TK.maxHold,m.holdT);m.state={c:m.col,r:0,L:{lights:false}};return}
   h.done=true;m.holdT=0;break}
  d5tkClaim(m);
  const nd0=m.d+v*dt,end=nd0>=L.total,nd=end?L.total:nd0,np=d5tkPose(L,nd),hit=a4FleetBlocked(m,np);
  if(hit&&!movingAwayFrom2(m,np,hit)&&!d5tkYielded(m,np,hit)){m.blocked+=dt;m.speed=0;D5TK.maxBlk=Math.max(D5TK.maxBlk,m.blocked);m.blockBy=hit;return}
  m.blocked=0;m.holdKind='';m.speed=v;m.d=nd;m.x=np.x;m.y=np.y;m.heading=np.heading;m.segment=np.segment;m.state={c:m.col,r:L.rev?1:0,L:{lights:false}};
  if(end){m.claim=null;if(L.stop>0){m.stopLeft=L.stop;m.stopEl=0;m.speed=0;if(L.at==='depot')D5TK.deliveries++;if(L.at==='bay'){D5TK.loads++;D5TK.laps++}}
   else{m.leg=(m.leg+1)%m.legs.length;m.route=m.legs[m.leg];m.d=0;for(const h of m.route.holds)h.done=false;for(const g of m.route.gates)g.done=false}}}catch(e){D5TK.err=D5TK.err||String(e&&e.message||e)}}
